title: Incidents Review Card
description: Optivion incidents summary (Figma 34:24312): a title, an optional filter, aggregated incident counts by state, an optional total, and one lifecycle track under the numbers, a segment per state sized by its count, drawn only when incidents have a lifecycle. The counts are headlines and need not sum to the total. HTML/Lit, no Redux.

filter.description: Scope of the counts. A distance ("5 km", or kind radius/distance) draws the scale mark; a site, region, unit, time or category prints as text. Omit it and the title stands alone.

counts.description: Aggregated incident counts by state, in lifecycle order. Each state's track segment is sized by its count. Two to four states share one layout.

tone.description: Dot and track colour. Defaults by position: green, red, amber, blue, violet.

total.description: Headline total. Not checked against the counts.

track.description: Draw the lifecycle track. Omitted, it shows with two or more states. Off, the numbers remain.
